source: GET /markets/ and GET /markets/{id}/ on live-api.panta.market, getAccountInfo on Solana mainnet
rule: tradeable phase, an account on chain, and a card carrying a question and a rule

markets.question: Will ICE Brent Crude Oil Futures (December 2026 Contract) settle at or above $104.00 per barrel on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 6:30 PM BST?
markets.resolutionRule: Resolve YES, if the official daily settlement price published by the Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) for the front-month December 2026 Brent Crude contract on Thursday, October 1, 2026, is exactly $104.00 or higher. Else resolve NO.

markets.question: Over 38.5 combined score in the Pittsburgh Steelers vs. Cleveland Browns game on Thursday, October 1, 2026?
markets.resolutionRule: Resolve YES, if the final combined score of both teams at the conclusion of the game is 39 points or higher. Else resolve NO.

markets.question: Will SpaceX’s Starship (Flight 14) successfully achieve its target Earth orbit and deploy at least one Starlink V3 satellite on or before Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM BST?
markets.resolutionRule: Resolve YES, if the official SpaceX Mission Broadcast or official telemetry data confirms that the Starship upper stage reached orbital velocity and successfully released at least one Starlink V3 payload into space before Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at exactly 5:59:00 PM CT. Else resolve NO.
